sections.heading: Common Scams and Security Problems
paragraph: Fake security alerts, impersonation calls, phishing messages, and unauthorized remote access are common reasons clients ask for help.
items: Fake virus or security alerts that display a phone number
Calls or messages pretending to come from a bank, technology company, delivery service, or government agency
Requests for gift cards, cryptocurrency, wire transfers, or other unusual payments
Phishing messages that imitate account warnings, invoices, or delivery notices
Remote-access software installed by an unknown or untrusted person

faq.question: Do you provide on-site service in Ocala?
faq.answer: Yes. We serve homes and small businesses throughout Ocala and Marion County. Arranged pickup and drop-off may also be available when that fits the work better.

faq.question: Can you help remotely without visiting first?
faq.answer: Plan-based remote support requires an in-person enrollment visit. Online training and tutoring are separate services and do not require the Remote Support Plan.

faq.question: A pop-up says my computer is infected and tells me to call. What should I do?
faq.answer: Do not call the number or allow anyone to connect to the computer. Close the browser if possible. If someone already connected, disconnect the computer from the internet and turn it off, then contact us for help.

faq.question: Someone called claiming to be my bank or a technology company. How can I verify the call?
faq.answer: End the call and contact the organization through a phone number on its official website, your account statement, or the back of your card. Do not use a number provided by the caller.

faq.question: Do I need to understand the technical problem before contacting you?
faq.answer: No. Describe what you see, when it started, and which devices are affected. We will help identify the right starting point and explain the options in plain English.

faq.question: How much does service cost?
faq.answer: The cost depends on the work. We explain the expected price before service begins and do not add work without discussing it with you.
